reason: We just finished migrating off E-Golf4U and our volunteers are exhausted; I cannot go back to the board and members asking for another switch a year later. On top of that, €249 a month plus a migration fee is real money for a 9-hole club that is losing members, from two founders with no club live yet.
objection: Our older members will not install and use yet another new app, and the volunteers who would have to run a second migration are already burned out. If these two founders stop, we are stuck again.
would_change_my_mind: Our current system failing badly in the next year or two, plus seeing Golfclub Zwolle running live for a full season with older members actually using the app, and you doing the whole migration for free.
